investigations.name: genotype-phenotype-baseline
investigations.description: This study trains two classical classifiers on synthetic multi-omic data generated by the same pipeline used in the quantum classifier evaluation. Both classifiers are evaluated on held-out test sets with the same train/test ratio. Results establish the baseline the quantum classifier must beat.
investigations.title: Classical Baselines — Random Forest and Logistic Regression on Synthetic Multi-Omic Data
investigations.objective: What is the best AUC-ROC and F1 score achievable with classical ML methods on synthetic multi-omic phenotype prediction, to establish a baseline for quantum classifier comparison?

investigations.name: quantum-classifier-evaluation
investigations.description: This study runs the GenotypeToPhenotypeProcess on synthetic multi-omic data with 4 modalities, 6 features per modality, 60 training and 100 test samples, 0.15 noise. The circuit uses M qubits, Rot encoding, pre-entanglement rotations, a CNOT chain, post-entanglement rotations, and fidelity measurement on qubit 0. Training: 6 epochs, Adam (lr=0.4), batch size 16. The interactive Marimo notebook provides a walkthrough with live plots and classical ML benchmarks computed side-by-side.
investigations.title: Quantum Classifier Evaluation — GenotypeToPhenotypeProcess on Synthetic Multi-Omic Data
investigations.objective: Can the GenotypeToPhenotypeProcess match or exceed classical ML baselines in predicting binary phenotypes from synthetic multi-omic data?

investigations.name: v2ecoli-real-data
investigations.description: This study closes the loop from v2ecoli simulation to zarr store to ZarrMultiOmicLoader to GenotypeToPhenotypeProcess. It validates the loader handles real v2ecoli zarr structure (hive partitions, generation arrays, vector observables), the default modality map maps real observables correctly, and the quantum classifier can learn from biologically realistic data. Requires a v2ecoli simulation run with XArrayEmitter producing a zarr store.
investigations.title: Real-Data Validation — Loading and Classifying v2ecoli Zarr Stores
investigations.objective: Can the ZarrMultiOmicLoader correctly extract features from real v2ecoli zarr stores, and can the GenotypeToPhenotypeProcess classify phenotypes from this biologically realistic data?
